patronOf.en-US: The priest asks to announce the Gospel worthily
patronOf.pt-BR: O sacerdote pede para anunciar dignamente o Evangelho

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Cleanse my heart and my lips, O almighty God, who didst cleanse the lips of the prophet Isaias with a burning coal.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó onipotente Deus, assim como purificastes os lábios do Profeta Isaías com uma brasa de fogo, assim também purificais agora o meu coração e os meus lábios.

meta.basis: At Low Mass the priest or the server carries the Missal to the gospel corner; the priest, at the middle, 'junctis manibus ante pectus, levatisque ad Deum oculis, et statim demissis, tum profunde inclinatus, dicit secreto: Munda cor meum' (Ritus servandus VI.1–2). The deacon's Munda cor at Solemn Mass is already in the Gospel Acclamation card; this is the Low Mass form, with the book carried across.
meta.excerpt: content/do/web/www/missa/English/Ordo/Ordo.txt and Portugues/Ordo/Ordo.txt, # Evangelium, the Low Mass form: the first sentence of Munda cor meum (en-US cut at a comma made a full stop; pt-BR whole, lines joined, keeping the source's European spelling 'onipotente')
